Noor Halvorsen Fieldwork
WorkSeriesAboutContact

Landscapes made slowly, from walks taken early.

I draw places at the edge of the day: ridgelines before sunrise, fjords before the wind, fields in the hour after rain. Each piece starts as a pencil sketch in the field and is finished in the studio.

14 works

About

Noor Halvorsen grew up on a small island in the north and now works from a studio above a boatyard. Her landscapes have been shown in six countries and appear on book covers, posters and, once, a ferry.

She walks every morning and draws most of them.
